name: mercado_libre-marketplaces-mcp
description: Mercado Libre (marketplaces): me, get_product, update_price, list_sales. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_id.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_secret.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the seller's ADMIN account (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/mercado_libre: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent) so they never race on one single-use refresh token.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_seller_id.description: Numeric Mercado Libre user id of the seller (the `id` returned by GET /users/me); used as the seller filter of the order search.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_ENV
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /users/me returns the authorised user {id, nickname, site_id, country_id, ...}; its id is the seller_id config value.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /items/{item_id} (e.g. MLA1136716168) returns the item {id, title, price, currency_id, available_quantity, sold_quantity, status active|paused|closed|under_review, permalink, date_created, last_updated, ...}. The description lives at /items/{id}/description and is not fetched.

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: CHANGES THE LIVE PRICE: PUT /items/{item_id} {price} ('When item is active you can modify ... Price') in the item's own currency_id (major units, e.g. 1000 = ARS 1,000); `currency` is ignored. Items with variations price each variation separately (not mapped). Returns the updated item.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /orders/search?seller={config seller_id}&order.date_created.from=`since` (ISO-8601)&sort=date_desc&offset&limit (page size 50): orders {id, status (paid, confirmed, cancelled ...), total_amount, currency_id, date_created, order_items[{item{id, title}, quantity, unit_price}], buyer{id}}. product_id / product_name are the FIRST order item; `product_id` input is not sent (no documented item filter). Buyer emails are not exposed.
